mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: A web-based local multiplayer party game platform in free Early Access with 18 competitive, action-based mini-games. Up to 8 players per game use their mobile phones (or gamepads) as controllers, and everything runs completely in the browser with no downloads or installs required. Games use quick ~one-minute rounds to keep pace and exclude language-based trivia or asynchronous play. The platform plans to open up to third-party developers and game jams, taking care of network connectivity and controllers so developers can focus on building multiplayer mini-games without the networking and infrastructure work. The project won silver at the Big Indie Pitch competition.
mentions.problem: Building multiplayer games normally requires spending an eternity on networking code and infrastructure; the platform takes care of connectivity and controllers so third-party developers can focus on making mini-games.
mentions.audience: Party game players (up to 8 players per game, local multiplayer on a shared screen); in the future, third-party developers building multiplayer mini-games on the platform
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a web-based local multiplayer party game platform. It's like a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party: https://gamingcouch.com. We just won silver at the Big Indie Pitch competition as well!
